parts.instruction: You will hear three different extracts. For questions 1-6, choose the answer (A, B or C) which fits best

questions.prompt: How does the boy feel about the main band?

options.label: disappointed by their performance
confused by all the advanced publicity
unsure whether he got value for money or not

questions.prompt: What is the woman doing in her reply?

options.label: criticising the support band
defending the approach of the media
agreeing with comments about the main band

questions.prompt: What is the male presenter doing?

options.label: praising changes that the manager has made
suggesting that rumours about the manager are unfounded
describing a growing sense of dissatisfaction with the manager’s performance

questions.prompt: In the female presenter’s opinion

options.label: the manager’s strategy is the correct one
the real problem is a lack of talented players
the pressure on the manager is likely to increase

questions.prompt: What does the woman particularly admire about the artist?

options.label: the originality of his work
the way his art has developed
the issues that his sculptures raise

questions.prompt: What disappointed them both about the exhibition?

options.label: the pieces of work that had been chosen
the information provided for visitors
the way it had been laid out HINTS AND KEYWORDS

parts.instruction: You will hear a man called Carl Pitman, giving a group of tourists practical advice about learning the sport of surfing. For questions 7-14, complete the sentences.

questions.prompt: Carl recommends the ________ as the best place for learning to surf in his area.
Carl uses the term ________ to describe the distance between waves.
Carl advises getting a wetsuit that has a ________ fit.
Carl says it’s important to check the quantity of material beneath the ________ of a new wetsuit.
Carl says that the wetsuit, ________ and footwear all need washing regularly.
According to Carl, a hanger made of ________ is best for storing wetsuits.
Beginners most often damage surfboards through contact with ________ .
Carl suggests using a ________ as the first step in removing wax from a surfboard.

parts.instruction: You will hear an interview with a writer called Barry Pagham, who writes crime novels. For questions 15-20, choose the answer (A, B, C or D) which fits best according to what you hear.

questions.prompt: What does Barry say about his first two published novels?

options.label: They were more successful than he anticipated
They were useful in proving that he could write
It’s a shame that they’re no longer available to buy
It was a mistake to write an unfashionable type of novel

questions.prompt: Barry admits that when he wrote the novel Transgression,

options.label: he only did it to please his publishers
he didn’t expect it to be so well received
he didn’t intend to produce any more like it
he never meant it to be sold as a horror story

questions.prompt: Looking back, how does Barry view his decision to write his first crime novel?

options.label: He accepts that he took a big risk
He wishes that he hadn’t upset his publishers
He recognises that he behaved unprofessionally
He regrets putting himself under so much stress

questions.prompt: Barry tells the story of the arrest of an armed robber to illustrate

options.label: how true to life his novels are
how dangerous his research can be
how seriously the police take his work
how unpredictably criminals can sometimes behave

questions.prompt: What does Barry say about the city where his novels are based?

options.label: He makes it sound more exciting than it actually is
He regards it as an important element in the stories
He doesn’t attempt to create a realistic picture of it
He’s surprised that foreign readers want to visit it

questions.prompt: How would Barry feel about becoming a policeman?

options.label: He suspects that he wouldn’t be brave enough
He doubts whether he would have the patience
He’s sure someone of his age wouldn’t be accepted
He suggests that he wouldn’t reject the idea completely HINTS AND KEYWORDS
